in_marathi.name: Mersal
in_marathi.long_meaning: Mersal हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Tamil language, Mersal means 'strong' or 'invincible'. This name is associated with the Hindu god Murugan, who is known for his strength and courage.
